visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Rain falls heavily on a busy Tokyo street crossing surrounded by tall commercial buildings. Pedestrians wearing dark coats hold umbrellas while walking across the glistening, wet pavement. In the foreground, a bowl of salad sits on a wooden table, partially obscured by raindrops on the camera lens. (2) In a bright outdoor area, three life-sized statues of characters from the 'KochiKame' anime stand on pedestals. The characters include a man in a blue police uniform, another in yellow, and a woman in a pink suit. The scene transitions to the Kameari Station entrance sign displayed under a blue awning. (3) The camera shows the exterior of the 'Ario Kameari' shopping mall, displaying logos for H&M and UNIQLO. Inside, the woman in a cream puffer jacket enters the 'Food Marche' supermarket area, pushing a green cart past various food stalls and brightly lit signage under white ceiling lights. (4) The woman explores the supermarket aisles, starting with the bakery where she picks up a large, soft bun from a wooden shelf. She then moves to the dairy section, browsing many brands of milk, and the produce section where she examines several packs of fresh, red strawberries. (5) Handheld shots showcase various snacks like fruit jellies, chocolate-covered strawberries in colorful pouches, and specialized seasonings. The woman also checks the beverage section, picking up a limited edition Sapporo beer can, and the personal care aisle featuring lip balms and household sponges on well-organized shelves. (6) The scene shifts to 'TOYLO PARK,' a vibrant children's playground area. The woman walks through a purple castle-shaped entrance into a massive room filled with rows of gashapon machines and crane games. She gestures excitedly at the toys and holds up a Disney Princess Frozen costume. (7) In the drugstore and cosmetics department, the woman browses Canmake makeup displays and various skincare products. The video concludes with shots of the information counter for tax-free shopping and a final exterior view of the Ito-Yokado building before transitioning to a QR code outro.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 2025 東京最佳 雨天備案. [Logo]: 日本失心瘋. (2) [Subtitle]: 超推薦去「龜有」 一家大小都能玩得開心. (3) [Subtitle]: 「龜有站」- 南口出來 往左前方走路5分鐘!. (4) [Subtitle]: 就到「Ario龜有店」 這裡有超好逛的 伊藤洋華堂. (5) [Subtitle]: 一樓有媽媽們愛逛的超市. [Slogan]: Food Marche. (6) [Subtitle]: 我每次逛至少要兩小時. (7) [Subtitle]: 龜有店有賣在地知名麵包店的麵包. (8) [Subtitle]: 吉田麵包 好鬆軟、好好吃. (9) [Subtitle]: 除了特色麵包 還有很多其他選擇. (10) [Subtitle]: 牛奶也是選擇一大堆 愛喝牛奶一定要來這裡. (11) [Subtitle]: 現在是草莓季 來這可以買到超多品種. (12) [Subtitle]: 這裡的價格也很便宜. (13) [Subtitle]: 喜歡蜜柑果凍的話 超推這二款唷. [Slogan]: FRUIT JELLY. (14) [Subtitle]: 伊藤洋華堂 東西真的好多好多 每次來都很多新商品. (15) [Subtitle]: 巧克力軟糖 又推出新口味了 這個看到就要掃貨. (16) [Subtitle]: 薯條專用調味料 可以買來自己調味道. [Slogan]: 新商品. (17) [Subtitle]: 札幌啤酒限定啤酒 只有7&i集團買得到 ※未成年請勿飲酒，喝酒不開車※. (18) [Subtitle]: 超市裡也有很多日用品 這支無添加護唇膏 99%使用食品成分. (19) [Subtitle]: 這個是專門產週期的護墊 提供給備孕的朋友參考. (20) [Subtitle]: 三星廚師推薦的菜瓜布 真的很好用，我有買. (21) [Subtitle]: 三樓是孩子的天堂 「TOYLO PARK」規劃成遊樂園的樣貌. [Logo]: TOYLO PARK. (22) [Subtitle]: 這裡之前大改裝 現在變得好好玩啊. (23) [Subtitle]: 光是扭蛋區就超大. (24) [Subtitle]: 是一座扭蛋城堡. (25) [Subtitle]: 看不完的扭蛋 太興奮了. (26) [Subtitle]: 而且有很多新款. (27) [Subtitle]: 夾娃娃機也超多台. [Slogan]: CRANE GAME. (28) [Subtitle]: 小女生來可以專攻冰雪區. [Logo]: Disney PRINCESS. (29) [Subtitle]: 琳瑯滿目的公主裝 (來這買比迪士尼便宜很多). (30) [Subtitle]: 家有女孩的一定要來這區逛逛. (31) [Subtitle]: 2樓家居用品很好挖寶 可愛家用品超多的. (32) [Subtitle]: 2樓還有藥妝專區 可以一次在這買齊，一起退稅. (33) [Subtitle]: 有很多開架商品 化妝品、保養品都有. (34) [Subtitle]: 藥品也很齊全 不用去藥妝店擠人 在這挑選舒服很多. (35) [Subtitle]: 全部買完後 再到一樓辦理退稅 不用跑很多趟，超方便. (36) [Subtitle]: 推薦你們下次去逛逛.
